export_focalnet_to_executorch: run optimum-cli to export a focalnet model to executorch format with xnnpack recipe
test_focalnet_image_classification_xnnpa: test focalnet image classification by comparing eager pytorch output against executorch xnnpack output
test_focalnet_image_classification_porta: test focalnet image classification by comparing eager pytorch output against executorch portable output
load_focalnet_executorch_model: load a focalnet model from huggingface and lower it to executorch using ExecuTorchModelForImageClassification
compare_eager_vs_executorch_outputs: compare eager pytorch model logits against executorch model forward pass outputs using check_close_recursively
